integrity: All affirmative rows have a concrete factor witness; all negative rows follow from a proved five-digram substitution cover plus exhaustive integer checks; Python standard-library verifier and data are included.
scientific_limitations: Complete exact classification only for integer orders 1 through 1705; no infinite-order characterization. Equivalent unpublished or unindexed finite tables may exist.
title: Exact additive and Abelian four-power order spectra of the Tribonacci word through \(1705\)
